description: This file defines a PHP class ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends FilterParams and is used to encapsulate filtering parameters for searching review KPIs, including review ID and reviewer group name. It also sets a default sort field.

classes.name: ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for specifying search filter parameters related to review KPIs, including review ID and reviewer group name, with a predefined sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a default sort field 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Returns the current review ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewId
methods.description: Sets the review ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reviewer group used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Sets the reviewer group name filter parameter.
